description:
Make OctoPi.AI.Providers.Anthropic.Request detect and use an OAuth token (starts with sk-ant-oat). When OAuth:
- Header `authorization: Bearer <token>` (no x-api-key)
- Extra beta headers: `claude-code-20250219,oauth-2025-04-20` (+ optional interleaved-thinking)
- `user-agent: claude-cli/<version>`, `x-app: cli`
- Prepend identity system prompt: "You are Claude Code, Anthropic's official CLI for Claude."
- Tool names normalized to Claude Code canonical casing on outbound (to\ClaudeCodeName); reverse-normalized on inbound (fromClaudeCodeName via case-insensitive lookup in context.tools)

New module: OctoPi.AI.Providers.Anthropic.Auth — source precedence: explicit opts.api_key → ANTHROPIC_OAUTH_TOKEN → ANTHROPIC_API_KEY → keychain (opi-y1y.2) → raise.

Port the unit-testable parts of pi-mono/packages/ai/test/anthropic-tool-name-normalization.test.ts (the normalization round-trip semantics) as pure tests.
title: OAuth use: auth resolution, request-shape variant, tool-name normalization
